'''''The Will of Exar Kun''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] extant in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], specifically sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Copies of the painting were available for purchase in the [[City/Legends|township]] of [[Aurilia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to those who had assisted the town significantly. The painting had a [[Color/Legends|white]] background and depicted three [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] figures wearing black [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and hoods, the forwardmost of whom held a black [[Staff/Legends|staff]] in the left [[Limb/Legends|hand]]. The figures stood upon a gray, cobblestone floor and encircled a tall, red [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] that stood on its tip. A greenish haze in the shape of a [[Gender/Legends|man's]] face, believed to be that of the ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], gazed at the viewer from behind the cowled figures.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Will of Exar Kun'' was a painting that appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It was added to the game on [[April 3]], [[2008]] as part of the ''Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun'' update. It could be purchased from vendors in the township of Aurilia with special "Heroic tokens" the player character received for completing the game's "Heroic Encounters." Once purchased, the player could use it as decoration in their character's home.<ref name="SWG" />
